activity.notes: The Old Tibetan Annals record mGar Khri 'bring btsan brod defeating a Tang army led by Wang Zhangshao in 'A zha in 695. This is a source-verified representative military activity point, NOT the whole span of his command or his separate office as chief minister. Also known as Lun Qinling (論欽陵).

sources.title: Prosopography of the Tibetan Empire — mGar Khri 'bring btsan brod
sources.citation_text: Review of the Old Tibetan Annals PT 1288 and PT 1287 documents the 695 campaign and 698–699 downfall.
